items.question: What is Trip Mitra Go?
items.answer: Trip Mitra Go is a trusted car rental and taxi booking platform offering local, outstation, airport transfer, one-way, and round-trip cab services with professional drivers and transparent pricing.

items.question: Which cities does Trip Mitra Go serve?
items.answer: Trip Mitra Go primarily serves Central India, including Raipur, Bilaspur, Durg, Bhilai, Jagdalpur, Jabalpur, Balaghat, Gondia, Nagpur, and nearby cities.

items.question: What types of trips can I book?
items.answer: You can book local city rides, outstation trips, one-way cabs, round trips, airport transfers, railway station pickups, wedding car rentals, and corporate travel.

items.question: How can I book a car?
items.answer: You can book a car through our website booking form or by contacting our customer support team.

items.question: Are your prices transparent?
items.answer: Yes. We provide transparent pricing with no hidden charges. Any tolls, parking fees, or applicable taxes are communicated clearly before your trip.

items.question: Can I modify or cancel my booking?
items.answer: Yes. Booking modifications and cancellations are available according to our cancellation policy. Please contact our support team as early as possible.
